summary: M.U.G.E.N is Elecbyte's customizable 2D fighting-game engine, whose archive route is about engine version, screenpack, character roster, stages, and legal/provenance state rather than a fixed campaign.

entries.title: M.U.G.E.N
entries.definitive_edition: Documented Elecbyte Windows build with roster/stage/screenpack state

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Exact M.U.G.E.N build with content pack and provenance documented

primary.version: Elecbyte M.U.G.E.N 1.1 beta / 1.0 route, recorded by build
primary.why: M.U.G.E.N is a fighting-game engine with user-made characters, stages, and screenpacks; fidelity depends almost entirely on build and content pack. The official Elecbyte site is not a normal active storefront route, so the archive should document the exact engine distribution and content provenance.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved Elecbyte build. Record engine version, motif/screenpack, character roster, stage set, lifebars, plugins, resolution, controller mapping, match format, AI difficulty, and rights/provenance of included content.

secondary.why: They are not the base engine.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat arbitrary fan compilations as the base engine route.
